pricing.details: Free 0 €/month, forever — unlimited highlight explanations, ask follow-up questions, import your Zotero library, powered by basic AI models. Pro 14 €/month, 7-day free trial — click graphs, figures and equations to explain them, explanations powered by GPT-6 Sol, automatic paper outlines with clickable page references, save highlights and explanations, ask questions about your paper. Teams — contact us (everything in Pro, team management, priority support, volume discounts). All plans billed through Stripe.
